description: Rendered text (SPEC.md §3.1) that every implementation must produce for each markdown input. One case per rule, plus the syntax most likely to drift between a markdown parser and an editor's document model.

cases.name: paragraphs and headings
soft line breaks and whitespace runs collapse
emphasis, strong and strikethrough keep their text
links and autolinks keep their text
cases.text: see the doc and https://x.dev or https://y.dev

cases.name: reference links keep their text, definitions contribute nothing
inline code contributes its content
escapes and entities are decoded
hard break (backslash) is one space
hard break (two spaces) is one space
inline raw HTML counts as written
inline HTML comment counts as written
raw HTML block is a text block
image with a title contributes nothing
image without a title contributes nothing
footnote reference contributes nothing, its definition is a block
table cells are text blocks, pipes contribute nothing
task list markers contribute nothing
nested lists and block quotes contribute their blocks
code block content is kept as written
thematic break has no text
CJK-friendly emphasis
